theme.title: Rip City
theme.subtitle: Portland, 1976–77
theme.recap: Bill Walton's Blazers came from 0–2 down to win the 1977 title, then started the next season 50–10.

questions.prompt: In the 1977 title clincher, how many rebounds did Bill Walton grab?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bill Walton's 20 points, 23 rebounds, 7 assists and 8 blocks kept the game in Portland's favor.

questions.prompt: The year after their title, how many of their first 60 games did the 1977–78 Blazers win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 1977-78 Blazers started with 50 wins in their first 60 games

questions.prompt: Portland scored how many points in the third quarter of Game 4 of the 1977 Finals?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Portland quickly led the game by 17 points and never looked back, scoring 41 points in the third quarter

questions.prompt: By how many points did Portland win Game 4 of the 1977 Finals?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 32 point win being the largest margin of victory in a Finals game 4 until 2024

questions.prompt: Bill Walton grabbed 24 rebounds in Game 5 of the 1977 Finals. How many were defensive?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 24 (20 defensive, another team record) of which belonged to Walton alone; his team record still stands.
